user.title: Welcome to Covermood
user.description:
Covermood colors the lights of a room to match the cover art of the music playing, with a smooth gradient across all bulbs. It works with every music service that provides cover art in Home Assistant.

Next we set up the first room. You can add more rooms later on the integration page.

room.title: Room
room.description: Pick an area from Home Assistant. Its media players and lights are suggested in the next step. Without an area, just enter a name.

data_description.name: Leave empty to use the area name.

devices.title: Players and lights
devices.description: As soon as one of these players is playing, Covermood colors the lights. With several players, the first one currently playing wins.

data_description.lights: The order you select them in is the direction of the gradient, e.g. left to right. Only lights that support color are offered.

look.title: Mood
look.description: You can change everything here later. Switch the mood any time with the room's select entity.

data.turn_on: Turn on lights that are off

data_description.points: How many colors are read from the cover. Covermood blends a gradient between them.
data_description.turn_on: Lights that are off when the music starts are turned on. Afterwards Covermood never turns anything on.
data_description.restore: When the music ends (after a short wait to cover pauses), the lights return to their previous state.

error.name_required: Pick an area or enter a name.
error.no_players: Pick at least one media player.
